entries.title: Front Mission
entries.definitive_edition: FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake with Mercenaries update

primary.version: FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake with Mercenaries update
primary.why: The Windows remake is the highest-fidelity route and its free Mercenaries update adds new single-player scenarios, local multiplayer, new maps, and extra mercenary content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC with the Mercenaries update installed; use modern visuals for the main run and classic mode only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remake modernizes presentation and adds update content, so purists may still sample the Super Famicom or DS releases for comparison.

entries.title: Front Mission 2

emulation.emulator: Native Windows; DuckStation for historical comparison
emulation.notes: Use native PC for the main playthrough. Use PlayStation emulation only for a version-history segment.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remake preserves the original game while adding modern presentation and quality-of-life features; purists may still compare the 1997 PlayStation release.
